probes.name: logical_revenue_plan
argv: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PAID' AND is_deleted = 0 AND customer_internal = 0 THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END) FROM "order"
probes.stdout: WITH `order` AS (SELECT `wren_src_order`.amount_cents AS amount_cents, `wren_src_order`.customer_internal AS customer_internal, `wren_src_order`.`status` AS status, `wren_src_order`.is_deleted AS is_deleted FROM (SELECT __relation__1.amount_cents, __relation__1.is_internal AS customer_internal, __relation__1.is_deleted, __relation__1.`status` FROM (SELECT `order`.amount_cents, `order`.customer_id, `order`.is_deleted, customer.is_internal, `order`.`status` FROM (SELECT customer.customer_id, customer.is_internal FROM (SELECT customer.customer_id, customer.is_internal FROM (SELECT __source.customer_id AS customer_id, __source.is_internal AS is_internal FROM wren_gap_fixture.ds_customer AS __source) AS customer) AS customer) AS customer RIGHT OUTER JOIN (SELECT __source.amount_cents AS amount_cents, __source.customer_id AS customer_id, __source.is_deleted AS is_deleted, __source.`status` AS `status` FROM wren_gap_fixture.ds_order AS __source) AS `order` ON customer.customer_id = `order`.customer_id) AS __relation__1) AS `wren_src_order`) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PAID' AND is_deleted = 0 AND customer_internal = 0 THEN amount_cents ELSE 0 END) FROM `order`
